For this purpose , we developed a Bayesian learning model in which we combine ideas from optimal motor control and Mixture-of-Experts generalisation . The good correspondence between the Mixture-of-Kalman-Filters and our results thus suggests that , though explicit knowledge about the role of the contextual cues is necessary to separate the cue conditions , the learning process associated with each cue has an implicit learning component that is captured by the Kalman-filter .
